notes.title: Update patch September
notes.content:
Bosses should now able to be completed with S-rank.
Weird pause bug is fixed.
Spawn in error is fixed.
Updates to text.
+ a bunch of smaller fixes.

notes.title: Demo updated
notes.content:
Main issues dealt with:
[list]
[*] Your score is now updated if you get a higher score than the current highscore.
[*] Time stop time doesn't run out if you are paused.
[/list]

+ a number of smaller fixes and balancing.

Thanks for all the feedback!
